import { rwDel, rwGet, rwPatch, rwPost } from "/src/features/research-workspace/api/client.ts";
export async function listNotes(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/notes`);
  return r?.items ?? [];
}
export async function recentNotes(projectId, limit = 6) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/notes/recent`, { limit });
  return r?.items ?? [];
}
export async function createNote(projectId, input) {
  const r = await rwPost(`/projects/${projectId}/notes`, input);
  return r.note;
}
export async function patchNote(noteId, body) {
  const r = await rwPatch(`/notes/${noteId}`, body);
  return r.note;
}
export async function deleteNote(noteId) {
  await rwDel(`/notes/${noteId}`);
}
